# AIA Engineering Limited

> AIA Engineering designs, manufactures and supplies high-chromium wear, corrosion and abrasion-resistant castings for mining, cement, quarry and thermal power industries across 120+ countries.

## About AIA Engineering
Headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, AIA Engineering Limited (NSE: AIAENG, BSE: 532683, ISIN: INE212H01026) operates globally alongside Vega Industries. The company specializes in wear parts, high-chromium grinding media, SAG/ball mill liners, diaphragms, vertical roller mill parts, crusher components, and grinding circuit process optimization services.

## Core Solutions & Products
- [Home](https://www.aiaengineering.com/): Overview of advanced wear solutions for critical industrial operations.
- [Mining Solutions](https://www.aiaengineering.com/solutions/mining): Comminution and electrochemistry technologies for mining concentrators.
- [Mining Products](https://www.aiaengineering.com/solutions/mining/products): SAG and ball mill liners, Verti mill liners, high-chrome media, and fasteners.
- [Mining Services](https://www.aiaengineering.com/solutions/mining/services): Reline supervision, circuit surveys, JKSimMet modelling, and wear monitoring.
- [NGDS (Discharge Systems)](https://www.aiaengineering.com/solutions/mining/ngds): New generation discharge systems for SAG and ball mills.
- [Cement Solutions](https://www.aiaengineering.com/solutions/cement): Wear solutions for cement tube mills and vertical roller mills.
- [Cement Products](https://www.aiaengineering.com/solutions/cement/products): Classifying liners, diaphragms, rollers, and grinding media.
- [Quarry Products](https://www.aiaengineering.com/solutions/quarry/products): Blow bars, hammers, anvils, and wear plates for impact crushers.
- [Thermal Power Solutions](https://www.aiaengineering.com/solutions/thermal-power): Coal pulveriser wear parts for power generation utilities.
